remaining_gap: Repository source layout is documented but the full repository map is not.
Transition code exists but a canonical transition-table artifact is absent.
A consolidated matrix covering all safety dimensions and actions is missing.
Envelope code exists but a complete versioned payload-schema set is missing.
Registry implementation exists but the complete registered event inventory is not published as a canonical artifact.
Repository and data provenance are described separately; there is no cross-domain authority matrix.
Risk-related state is implemented but is not specified as a complete state model.
The reservation lifecycle is named but the complete actor/event/recovery flow is not documented.
A TTL primitive exists but its decision-class policy and expiry precedence are not specified.
Causal checks exist but a canonical end-to-end dependency graph artifact is absent.
Method contracts exist but there is no complete versioned inventory of approved statistical methods.
Gate dependencies are described but no exhaustive gate-by-dependency matrix is published.
Role/capability grants are explicit and tested; platform-wide resource entitlements, trusted identity, and role assignment are not implemented.
Recovery contracts exist but no unified restart runbook covers all services and failure classes.
Backup/restore primitives and readiness checks exist but RPO/RTO, backup custody and restore exercises are not specified in one plan.
